captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle dropper seatpost assembly with a matte black finish. It features a bottom frame seat-tube sleeve adapter, a quick-release binder clamp ring with an adjustable cam lever, a dual-stage telescoping outer and inner post, and a top-mounted two-bolt saddle perch. The telescoping inner tube moves linearly along the vertical axis of the outer tube, while the quick-release binder lever pivots on a horizontal axis to simulate clamp locking.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric 3D model of a two-stage bicycle dropper seatpost assembly. Include a bottom seat-tube adapter sleeve, a binder clamp ring with a pivoting quick-release cam lever, an outer post, a prismatic telescoping inner post, and a dual-bolt saddle perch at the top. Use realistic matte black materials for the main bodies and metallic silver for the mounting bolts.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject containing multiple parts. It constructs cylindrical shapes for the sleeve, clamp collar, outer post, and inner post. A box primitive is used to model the top saddle perch, while small tilted cylinders represent the mounting bolts. The quick-release lever is built from a custom cam profile combined with a cylinder pivot. Prismatic joints are defined for the telescoping tubes, and a revolute joint is used for the binder lever articulation.
